sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi có thể thanh toán bây giờ được không? is for asking permission before you act. It is useful when pay now depends on local rules, staff approval, or the right way to use a space or service.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi có thể thanh toán bây giờ được không? once, then make the task visible with your booking screen, room key, address, room number, or photo of the issue. The phrase is doing one job: getting a clear answer about pay now.
